entries.reason: draft gate reported missing migration parity inventory, owner mapping, behavior-level verification, and QA recommendation basis
entries.trigger: senti flow run gate --phase draft returned FAIL with migration-parity and draft-recommend-with-reasoning observations
entries.resolution: expanded draft impact and decision map with public surface inventory, retained behavior mapping, verification requirements, and explicit QA basis
entries.guardrailCandidate: drafts that change shared public behavior must include migration parity inventory, owner mapping, and behavior-level verification before gate

entries.reason: spec review found missing cache path confinement and resolved tree consistency requirements
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase spec returned FAIL with two blocking findings
entries.resolution: added path confinement to R3 and T-2, added R7 for resolved tree consistency, updated acceptance criteria and repair audit
entries.guardrailCandidate: specs requiring destructive managed-cache repair must state path confinement and tree-to-commit consistency before implementation

entries.reason: test review found stale-cache setup cloned after remote advanced and R2 lacked tag and SHA ref coverage
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with two blocking findings
entries.resolution: changed tests to advance remote after cache clone, added source.ref tag coverage, and added full-SHA dirty-cache coverage
entries.guardrailCandidate: spec-local cache update tests must create stale caches before advancing the remote and cover each ref kind named by acceptance criteria

entries.reason: test review found missing unrecoverable cache reclone coverage, overstated R5 public behavior coverage, and missing R7 install coverage
entries.trigger: second senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with three blocking findings
entries.resolution: added unrecoverable cache reclone test, source add/update config persistence test, official preset source resolution test, and install materialization test
entries.guardrailCandidate: test coverage artifacts must match actual public behavior tests for every preserved surface named in the spec

entries.reason: test review found unsafe path rejection did not prove escaped cache target remained untouched
entries.trigger: third senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with one blocking finding
entries.resolution: added sentinel file assertions outside plugin-sources and verified no .git checkout is created at escaped target
entries.guardrailCandidate: unsafe path tests for destructive operations must assert the out-of-scope target remains unmodified, not only that an error is thrown

entries.reason: implement completion failed because file-map entries were missing for testable requirements
entries.trigger: senti flow set step implement done returned IMPLEMENT_COMPLETION_VALIDATION_FAILED with file-map-missing
entries.resolution: recorded file-map entries for R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 and R7 before retrying implement completion
entries.guardrailCandidate: before marking implement done, record file-map entries for every testable requirement

entries.reason: impl review found ignored untracked files could survive managed Git cache repair
entries.trigger: impl-review blocking finding for R7 reported git clean -fd does not remove ignored files
entries.resolution: changed cache cleanup to git clean -fdx and added ignored-file regression coverage
entries.guardrailCandidate: managed Git cache repair must remove ignored untracked files before metadata consumers inspect the tree

entries.reason: impl review found existing managed cache could keep fetching from an old Git remote
entries.trigger: second impl-review blocking finding reported cache origin was not verified against source URL
entries.resolution: added origin URL verification with reclone on mismatch and covered same-id URL replacement
entries.guardrailCandidate: managed cache identity must include both source id and configured Git URL before fetch or ref resolution

entries.reason: impl review found symlinked managed cache path could redirect destructive Git repair outside plugin-sources
entries.trigger: third impl-review blocking finding reported path.resolve confinement missed symlink cache directories
entries.resolution: added lstat and realpath confinement checks and symlink sentinel regression coverage
entries.guardrailCandidate: before destructive managed-cache Git commands, reject symlinked cache paths and verify realpath confinement

entries.reason: impl review found redirected Git metadata could make cache repair operate on an external worktree
entries.trigger: fourth impl-review blocking finding reported .git file and core worktree redirection were not confined
entries.resolution: added .git directory and show-toplevel confinement checks plus redirected gitdir regression coverage
entries.guardrailCandidate: managed Git cache validation must confine both filesystem path and Git metadata before fetch reset clean or checkout

entries.reason: Confined Git metadata validation changed after the previous impl review finding.
entries.recoveryCommand: senti flow set retry reset review impl --reason "Confined Git metadata validation changed after the previous impl review finding." --yes

entries.reason: impl review found confined nested worktree metadata could make returned source root differ from Git top-level
entries.trigger: recovered impl-review blocking finding reported show-toplevel under cache but not equal to cache root
entries.resolution: required Git top-level realpath to equal the managed cache root and added nested-worktree reclone coverage
entries.guardrailCandidate: when returning a managed source root, require Git top-level to equal that exact root rather than merely being under it

entries.reason: Git top-level validation now requires exact managed cache root equality.
entries.recoveryCommand: senti flow set retry reset review impl --reason "Git top-level validation now requires exact managed cache root equality." --yes

entries.reason: impl review found symlinked .senti ancestor could redirect destructive cache creation and repair outside the project
entries.trigger: impl-review blocking finding reported .senti symlink was not rejected before plugin-sources mkdir and cache mutation
entries.resolution: rejected symlinked .senti paths before mkdir and revalidated managed cache path after creating plugin-sources
entries.guardrailCandidate: managed cache confinement checks must validate symlinked ancestors before any directory creation or destructive repair

entries.reason: Managed cache validation now rejects symlinked .senti ancestors before mkdir.
entries.recoveryCommand: senti flow set retry reset review impl --reason "Managed cache validation now rejects symlinked .senti ancestors before mkdir." --yes

finalize merge failed because feature branch conflicted with main during squash merge
